ui_bugs.issue: P0: HEAD fetch on /promo.mp4 returns 200 because the SPA dev server serves index.html as a fallback for any unmatched path. Result: hasLocalMp4 becomes true and a broken <video src='/promo.mp4'> is rendered instead of the required YouTube iframe (data-testid='promo-video-iframe'). The YouTube fallback never displays. Fix: check Content-Type header for 'video/' prefix, OR use a GET range request, OR ship a real /promo.mp4, OR default hasLocalMp4=false and require an explicit env flag. Replicated on preview URL: data-testid='promo-video' is present, data-testid='promo-video-iframe' is NOT present.

rca of the issue: PromoVideo.jsx uses fetch('/promo.mp4', { method: 'HEAD' }).then(r => setHasLocalMp4(r.ok)). In React SPA preview/prod builds, ANY unknown path is rewritten to index.html which returns HTTP 200, so r.ok is always true. Therefore hasLocalMp4 always becomes true, the conditional renders <video src='/promo.mp4'> which loads HTML as a broken video, and the YouTube iframe is never shown. Mitigation: change check to `fetch('/promo.mp4', { method: 'HEAD' }).then(r => setHasLocalMp4(r.ok && (r.headers.get('content-type') || '').startsWith('video/')))`.
